parse_mnist_m_labels: parse MNIST-m label files from a tarfile and return a dictionary mapping filenames to integer labels
run_mnist_m_handler: run the MNIST-m dataset handler to extract metadata and generate split data generators from a dataset path
download_mnist_m_dataset: download the MNIST-m dataset from Google Drive using the predefined DownloadableDataset configuration with checksum verification
generate_mnist_m_images: generate PIL Image and label tuples from the MNIST-m tarfile by iterating over image members and matching labels
deduplicate_mnist_m_data: deduplicate MNIST-m training and test data using the extraction_utils deduplicate_data_generator before splitting
